key: Hah?
en: Hah?
ja: はぁ?

key: Who are you?
en: Who are you?
ja: 誰?

key: Don't tell me you're here to challenge the league or something.
en: Don't tell me you're here to challenge the league or something.
ja: まさかリーグに挑戦しに来たとか言わないでよね。

key: ...Wait, really?
en: ...Wait, really?
ja: …ちょっと、マジで?

key: People are actually getting through it now?
en: People are actually getting through it now?
ja: 今どき実際に突破する奴がいるわけ?

key: Jesus, I figured enough of them would be dead, missing, or both that I'd never see a challenger up here.
en: Jesus, I figured enough of them would be dead, missing, or both that I'd never see a challenger up here.
ja: はぁ、死ぬか行方不明になるかその両方かで、ここに挑戦者が来ることなんて絶対ないだろうと思ってたのに。

key: I'll have you know I only took this job because I figured nobody would ever get up here!
en: I'll have you know I only took this job because I figured nobody would ever get up here!
ja: 言っとくけど、ここに誰も来ないと思ったからこの仕事を選んだんだからね!

key: Thought I could just get paid to do nothing, but no.
en: Thought I could just get paid to do nothing, but no.
ja: 何もしなくても給料もらえると思ってたのに、そうはいかなかった。

key: SOMEONE had to come along and ruin it.
en: SOMEONE had to come along and ruin it.
ja: 誰かさんが来て台無しにしてくれたわけ。

key: Now I gotta give you the rundown of the Elite Four challenge, huh?
en: Now I gotta give you the rundown of the Elite Four challenge, huh?
ja: これで四天王戦の説明をしなきゃいけないってわけね?

key: Well...
en: Well...
ja: まあ…

key: I don't wanna and you can't make me.
en: I don't wanna and you can't make me.
ja: やりたくないし、あんたに強制もできないし。

key: So there.
en: So there.
ja: だからね。

key: FINE, I'll tell you the stuff!
en: FINE, I'll tell you the stuff!
ja: はいはい、教えてあげるわよ!

key: It's all bullshit anyway-- if you already beat all the leaders, you know most of what you need to.
en: It's all bullshit anyway-- if you already beat all the leaders, you know most of what you need to.
ja: どうせ全部くだらない話。ジムリーダー全員倒してるなら、必要なことはもうほとんど知ってるでしょ。

key: You know the only thing that matters?
en: You know the only thing that matters?
ja: 唯一重要なことって何かわかる?

key: Elite Four members use two Types, not one.
en: Elite Four members use two Types, not one.
ja: 四天王は1タイプじゃなくて2タイプ使うってこと。

key: That's it.
en: That's it.
ja: それだけ。

key: That's literally it!
en: That's literally it!
ja: 本当にそれだけ!

key: They pay me the big bucks to sit at this desk and tell all of the nobody who comes through just that.
en: They pay me the big bucks to sit at this desk and tell all of the nobody who comes through just that.
ja: あたしはこの机に座って、通りかかる誰でもないような奴らにそれだけ伝えるために、高い給料をもらってるってわけ。

key: I mean, sure, I'm SUPPOSED to go through all of the technicals of the challenge...
en: I mean, sure, I'm SUPPOSED to go through all of the technicals of the challenge...
ja: まあ、一応挑戦の技術的な話も全部説明することになってるんだけど…

key: Like how you fight each one in a regular order and no one's going to be healing you between them, but...
en: Like how you fight each one in a regular order and no one's going to be healing you between them, but...
ja: 決まった順番で一人ずつ戦うとか、間に誰も回復してくれないとか、そういうの。でも…

key: Come on, who would get to this point and not know that?
en: Come on, who would get to this point and not know that?
ja: ねえ、ここまで来てそれを知らない奴なんている?

key: Not you, right?
en: Not you, right?
ja: あんたは知ってるでしょ?

key: That's what I thought.
en: That's what I thought.
ja: だと思った。

key: You can't use relearning or Move Tutor app during the challenge.
en: You can't use relearning or Move Tutor app during the challenge.
ja: 挑戦中は思い出しアプリも技教え屋アプリも使えない。

key: TMs are allowed for whatever dumb reason.
en: TMs are allowed for whatever dumb reason.
ja: なぜかは知らないけど、わざマシンは使っていい。

key: Elite Four matches always take place at Level 100 Pokémon because we're not babies.
en: Elite Four matches always take place at Level 100 Pokémon because we're not babies.
ja: 四天王戦は常にレベル100固定。あたしたちは赤ちゃんじゃないからね。

key: But at this point, what does that even matter?
en: But at this point, what does that even matter?
ja: でも今さらそんなの、どうでもよくない?

key: Just leave me alone; I wanna sleep.
en: Just leave me alone; I wanna sleep.
ja: 放っといて。眠りたいの。

key: What do you WANT from me.
en: What do you WANT from me.
ja: あたしに何を求めてるわけ。

key: Types: Two.
en: Types: Two.
ja: タイプ: 2つ。

key: Order: Fixed.
en: Order: Fixed.
ja: 順番: 固定。

key: Level: 100.
en: Level: 100.

key: TMs: Yes.
en: TMs: Yes.
ja: わざマシン: 可。

key: Relearn: No.
en: Relearn: No.
ja: 思い出し: 不可。

key: Move Tutor: No.
en: Move Tutor: No.
ja: 技教え: 不可。

key: Bye.
en: Bye.
ja: じゃあね。
